decision.reason: The user asked for a release once the delegated-drafter work worked in a live test, so the packages ship the delegated drafter with the review and comic runners (#208) and the Windows-safe claude -p arguments, the review binding that survives the comic and the cross-platform run lock (#209). The live test (#209 and #210, each written by Tracetoon with a comic) passed. The flagship prbench comparison for this design ran as a separate benchmark and is not the calibration/admission/confirmation round this contract records, so the CI-tested candidate is released without one. No evaluation result or performance gain is claimed.
